title: Subscription Relief Volume Measurement for Pocketwire Business Profiles
content:
The subscription relief volume of a Pocketwire Business Profile is chosen by the profile's age and claims record.

**Rule.** For a profile at least 24 whole months old with no chargeback dated within the rolling 3 months ending on the handling date, the subscription relief volume is the higher of the subscription relief net sales and the subscription relief three-month average. For a profile at least 12 whole months old that does not meet both of those conditions, it is the subscription relief three-month average. For any other profile it is the subscription relief net sales.

**Quantities.**
- The subscription relief net sales are the sales less the refunds less the chargebacks on the profile dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date.
- The subscription relief three-month average is the sales less the refunds less the chargebacks on the profile dated within the rolling 3 months ending on the handling date, divided by 3 and rounded to the nearest cent.
- A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date. A profile's age in whole months counts a month once the same day of the month as its opening date is reached.

## Truth table

| Age in whole months | Chargeback dated in the rolling 3 months | Subscription relief volume |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | none | the higher of the net sales and the three-month average |
| 24 or more | at least one | the three-month average |
| 12 to 23 | either | the three-month average |
| fewer than 12 | either | the net sales |

## Worked figure (hypothetical records)

Rolling-month net sales USD 41000.00; rolling 3-month net sales USD 100000.00, giving a three-month average of USD 33333.33.

- Profile 30 whole months old, no chargeback in the 3 months: USD 41000.00.
- Same profile with one chargeback in the 3 months: USD 33333.33.
- Profile 8 whole months old: USD 41000.00.
